title: Danaher agrees to acquire US medical tech company Masimo for $9.9B, paying $180 per share, a nearly 40% premium on February 13's close, set to close in H2 2026 (Stuart Biggs/Bloomberg)
summary: Stuart Biggs / Bloomberg: Danaher agrees to acquire US medical tech company Masimo for $9.9B, paying $180 per share, a nearly 40% premium on February 13's close, set to close in H2 2026 — Danaher Corp. agreed to buy US medical technology firm Masimo Corp., in a deal with an enterprise value of about $9.9 billion.
